status: scenario bank; not executed quality results

cases.input_scenario: A poem has a final stanza absent from an extracted preview.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the complete original; preserve the stanza and emotional turn.

cases.input_scenario: Two writers share a similar name.
cases.expected_behavior: Keep separate candidates until identity evidence supports a match.

cases.input_scenario: A supplied contributor has no central profile.
cases.expected_behavior: Create a provisional identity, research claims and link only the verified profile.

cases.input_scenario: An elephant illustration has a disconnected or missing limb.
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect full resolution and revise anatomy without replacing the story scene.

cases.input_scenario: A Similipal forest celebration is depicted as a snowy human picnic.
cases.expected_behavior: Base the visual brief on the actual story and supported Odisha setting.

cases.input_scenario: A poem about absence is illustrated by assembling all its nouns.
cases.expected_behavior: Consider a lived or indirect moment preserving the emotional anchor.

cases.input_scenario: A restrained poem becomes sentimental explanatory prose.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve voice, silence and final turn; remove added explanation.

cases.input_scenario: The approved original changes after translation review.
cases.expected_behavior: Flag translations and other downstream artifacts as stale.

cases.input_scenario: A broad text mask hides the cover artwork.
cases.expected_behavior: Use readable complementary lettering and local softening.

cases.input_scenario: Randomization leaks into edition contents or omits articles.
cases.expected_behavior: Randomize all current homepage articles only; preserve editorial sequence.

cases.input_scenario: An editorial draft invents the editor’s childhood memory.
cases.expected_behavior: Remove invented testimony and keep the intended editor’s approval explicit.

cases.input_scenario: High-confidence OCR drops a line or changes panel order.
cases.expected_behavior: Compare with original pages; do not equate confidence with approval.

cases.input_scenario: An unlisted book appears in a public catalogue.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve direct access boundaries and exclude public discovery.

cases.input_scenario: A correction for one poem overwrites every author’s style.
cases.expected_behavior: Store and retrieve the correction only within its justified scope.
